confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Berlin price levels; no live booking pages, menus or listings were inspected. Restaurant and drink anchors are more reliable than July 2026 accommodation rates. Euro prices were converted at an assumed EUR/USD of about 1.16 without a live rate check, so every USD anchor carries that conversion uncertainty. Cocktail and wine come from direct knowledge of Berlin bar prices; the beer ratio (cocktail about 2.6 times beer, glass of wine about 1.4 times beer) was used only as a sanity check.
comparable_city_reasoning: Priced against other large German and central European capitals with similar restaurant and hotel markets. The FX observation is the RBA USD/AUD rate for 14 October 2026; no web search was used to source city prices.
